title: A failed batch judge call keeps its raw reply and an empty verdict list is refused
goal: A failed factdiff judge call keeps its raw reply beside the judge file, JUDGE_SCHEMA or the call refuses an empty verdicts list, and a failed call is retried once or reported with its cause (the logs census of 2026-10-11 lost 20 items to one call that answered 'no entry matched an item').

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f
n=f.JUDGE_SCHEMA['properties']['verdicts'].get('minItems',0);print(n);sys.exit(0 if n>=1 else 1)
